config.theme: Shiki theme id. Empty = follow the current VS Code theme (auto-mapped).
config.windowStyle: Window style: macOS traffic lights / Windows buttons / none
config.lineNumbers: Line numbers: `off` / `relative` (count from the selection head) / `real` (document line numbers). Legacy `showLineNumbers` / `realLineNumbers` migrate automatically
config.languageOverride: Force a Shiki language id (e.g. `python`). Empty = follow the document language
config.maskStyle: Redaction mask style (F10): `block` solid bar / `asterisk` width-aligned asterisks. Create masks by selecting text in the preview and clicking "Mask"; click a mask to restore
config.backgroundType: Backdrop: `solid` (default) / `gradient` two-color / `grid` / `dots`. Grid and dots paint over the background color
config.gradientColorA: Gradient start color (applies when backgroundType = gradient)
config.gradientColorB: Gradient end color (applies when backgroundType = gradient)
config.gradientAngle: Gradient angle (degrees, CSS semantics: 0 = up, 90 = right, range 0-360)
config.watermarkText: Watermark text; empty = hidden. Placeholders: `{date}` (local date) and `{file}` (window title)
config.watermarkPosition: Watermark position: one of the corners, or tiled
config.fontFamily: Font family. Empty = follow the editor font (recommended; must be installed)
config.tabSize: Tab width. `0` = follow the document editor setting
config.uiLanguage: UI language: `auto` follows the VS Code display language (Simplified Chinese for zh environments, English otherwise) / `zh` / `en`
extension.description: 📷 Open-source code screenshot tool — select code, get a beautiful image. Highlighting follows your editor theme, Canvas-powered export, clipboard untouched.
